en.p: A pouch contains 12 balls with the natural numbers from 1 to 12 written on them, one each. Three balls are drawn at random from the pouch at the same time, and the numbers on the balls, in increasing order, are $a$, $b$, $c$. Given that $b-a\ge 5$, the probability that $c-a\ge 10$ is $\dfrac{q}{p}$. Find the value of $p+q$. (Here $p$ and $q$ are relatively prime natural numbers.) [4 points]
